stats.text: Starting at character level 5, you can change your size to Large as a {ref:glossary/bonus-action} if you're in a big enough space. This transformation lasts for 10 minutes or until you end it (no action required). For that duration, you have {ref:glossary/advantage} on Strength checks, and your Speed increases by 10 feet. Once you use this trait, you can't use it again until you finish a {ref:glossary/long-rest}.
